public abstract class EnumValueGenerator<K,SV extends Enum<SV>,FV> extends CachedValueGenerator<K,SV,FV>
A CachedValueGenerator whose source values are all constants of an enum.

  • Method Details

    • getEnumType

      public abstract Class<SV> getEnumType()
      Enum whose constants are the source values. CachedValueGenerator.update() creates the cache entries of all of them upfront. Must return the same type on every call; it is read once to cache the constants.
      Returns:
      enum type of the source values

    • getSourceValueStream

      public Stream<SV> getSourceValueStream()
      Description copied from class: CachedValueGenerator
      All source values the generator knows without a key, so CachedValueGenerator.update() can create their cache entries upfront. Empty by default: a key-only generator needs no override, while its entries are created lazily by CachedValueGenerator.apply(Object). Values that can only be reached through a key are returned by CachedValueGenerator.getSourceValueStream(Object) instead.
      Overrides:
      getSourceValueStream in class CachedValueGenerator<K,SV extends Enum<SV>,FV>
      Returns:
      stream of every key-independent source value
